findings.invariant_violated: Exterior access requires a matching opening
findings.description: The woman is depicted leaning forward out of the cabin with her forearms on the hood, in front of the windshield and the sloping front pillar. The actual side-window opening is behind that pillar, while the windshield behind her retains glazing and its lower frame without an opening for her torso. This places the cabin-to-exterior connection through the windshield instead of through the established side window.
